title: IVG Pro 12 Fresh Menthol Mojito Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Fresh Menthol Mojito IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods capture the vibrant flavour of a Mint and Lime Mojito with a brisk Menthol finish. The Mint lifts the citrus edge, while the icy streak rounds off the inhale with a cool, refreshing twist. Each refill pack contains a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, along with a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once clicked together, the refill system keeps your pod topped up automatically as you vape — delivering up to 10,000 puffs per kit with no refilling or coil changes required. With mesh coil technology for smooth MTL vapour and strong flavour throughout, these pods are designed exclusively for the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
